domain: Civil Engineering & Structural Concrete/Soil Testing Laboratory Management

principles: Data Density over Decorative Filler: Tables and grid metrics must prioritize scanability and precision
Strict Status Signal Hierarchy: Instant visual feedback with color-coded badges for compliance (Conforme, Ruptura Pendente, Em Dia, Calibração Próxima)
Frictionless Field & Lab Workflow: Fast input forms for concrete casting on site and rapid rupture calculation in lab
Multi-tenant & Responsive First: Isolated workspace experience with collapsible dark sidebar on desktop and bottom nav bar on mobile

mobile.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 bg-slate-900 border-t border-slate-800 flex justify-around items-center z-50 text-slate-300

key_workflows.flow: OBRA → CONCRETO → CORPOS DE PROVA → RUPTURA → RELATÓRIO PDF
key_workflows.ruptura_calculation: Resistência (MPa) = Carga (kN) * 10 / Área (cm²). Exemplo: CP 10x20 cm -> Área = 78.54 cm². Carga 250 kN -> 31.83 MPa.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement full pt-BR professional terminology for civil engineering concrete lab management.
Use data-testid attribute on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, table rows).
Ensure dark sidebar (#0f172a) on desktop and smooth transition to mobile bottom navigation.
Provide modal/dialog CRUD forms for Obras, Concreto, Corpos de Prova, Ruptura, Equipamentos.
Include automatic rupture strength calculation formula: MPa = (Carga kN * 10) / Area cm2.
Implement multi-tenant company switcher in top header and profile avatar dropdown.
Provide PDF report generation modal with preview layout including headers, lab logo, test summary table, and technical signatures.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic placeholder text; use realistic engineering data (e.g., FCK 30 MPa, Slump 120±20mm, Usina Concremix, Prensa Hidráulica Eletromecânica 2000 kN).
All form fields must have clear labels, units (MPa, kN, mm, cm², m³), and input validation feedback.
Keep contrast high and table layouts clean with hover effects and explicit action buttons (Visualizar, Editar, Excluir, Lançar Ruptura).
